_note: Model IDs + fallbacks per need, all via OpenRouter (one key: OPENROUTER_API_KEY). Prices are USD estimates for the budget check only; the recorded spend uses OpenRouter's actual generation cost when it is reported. Model IDs checked against openrouter.ai/api/v1/models on 2026-10-11. promo.json "provider_overrides" can replace any field per project, e.g. { "tts": { "default": "…" } }.

gotchas: Plain-prose directions are read aloud; put style in [tags]
An inline tag at the opening ([excited] First line…) sets the energy
Output is raw PCM 24 kHz s16le mono
Takes sometimes hallucinate or drop words; always diff the STT transcript against the script
Drifts into retro funk/disco when a long brief leads the prompt; use a style-only prompt
Tracks have no hard ending; place the music on the onset of the last chord
Zero-data-retention (ZDR) accounts may be blocked; the next fallback is tried
Ask for the subject on solid #FF00FF for the chroma key
Edits can't restructure geometry (e.g. change a sail type); regenerate from text instead
Adds stray ground lines under subjects; erase them on the raw image before processing
AssemblyAI accepts WAV only; convert first
Brand names get misheard; normalise them with theme.json brandWords
One clip per request (multi-clip comparisons swap clip identities)
Parrots timestamps from the prompt; verify timing claims with STT or plots
